INDIA_INDUSTRIAL_INCIDENTS_2025.description: Specific documented industrial fires, deflagrations, and warehouse blazes with exact dates and facility names (SEBI Reg 30 filings, SPCB/NGT orders, verified news).
INDIA_INDUSTRIAL_INCIDENTS_2025.scientific_limitation: Satellite temporal gap: NOAA-20 has only 2 overpasses/day (~13:20 and ~01:20 local time); fires extinguished within hours outside overpass window produce no thermal anomaly.

FSI_VAN_AGNI_LFF_2025.description: Forest Survey of India (FSI) Large Forest Fire (LFF) multi-pixel clusters and state forest department beat verification logs with start/end dates.
FSI_VAN_AGNI_LFF_2025.scientific_limitation: Without automated 10m/20m Sentinel-2 dNBR burn-scar raster overlay, point cluster radius represents a coarse spatial centroid.

ICAR_IARI_CREAMS_2025.description: Daily agricultural crop residue burning monitoring bulletins reporting active burning at revenue village and tehsil block centroids.
ICAR_IARI_CREAMS_2025.scientific_limitation: Village centroids (~3 to 5 km span) provide regional agricultural context only; they do NOT prove an individual 375m VIIRS pixel was an active stubble burn on a specific farm parcel.

INDIA_OTHER_THERMAL_SOURCES_2025.description: Stationary, multi-year, and persistent thermal emitters: continuous gas flare stacks, active brick kilns, Barren Island volcanic vent, coal seam fire fields, and thermal power stations.
INDIA_OTHER_THERMAL_SOURCES_2025.scientific_limitation: Static asset inventories do NOT represent discrete fire disaster events. Proximity to a known source over a 15-month window indicates operational thermal infrastructure, not an acute emergency.

critical_findings.event_vs_static_source_conflation: 1,870 out of 1,875 labeled detections (99.73%) were generated by 11 static infrastructure locations (coalfield, volcano, flare, power station) rather than discrete disaster events.
critical_findings.false_tier_a_promotion: 1,357 detections were promoted to Tier A Confirmed purely because colliery shapefiles were issued by statutory authorities (CMPDI/BCCL). Proximity to a multi-year mining boundary is static asset context, NOT proof of an acute thermal disaster event.
critical_findings.agricultural_spatial_coarseness: The 1 matched agricultural detection occurred at 3.47 km from a village centroid. Village-level bulletins are CONTEXT_ONLY and cannot prove parcel-level stubble burning.
critical_findings.supervised_class_imbalance: Real discrete event evidence yielded only 2 Industrial, 2 Forest, 0 Agricultural, and 0 Other events. A supervised 4-class classifier cannot be trained on this sample.
critical_findings.validation_of_deep_sad_paradigm: This severe sparsity confirms that semi-supervised anomaly detection (Deep SAD) is scientifically necessary. The 1,173,920 unlabeled detections form the authentic background distribution, while industrial fires represent an extreme anomaly tail.
